skill.summary: Manage restaurant operations with recipe creation, inventory prediction, menu optimization, staff scheduling, and food safety compliance.

latestVersion.changelog:
Restaurant Operator 1.0.0 — initial release

- Combines culinary (Chef Brain) and business (Operator Brain) AI for restaurant management
- Features include recipe creation, ingredient substitution, flavor balancing, inventory prediction, menu engineering, staff scheduling, and food safety monitoring
- Supports use cases for new and existing restaurants, food trucks, catering, and ghost kitchens
- Integrates with POS, inventory management, weather APIs, and reservation systems
- Flexible pricing tiers for different business needs
